L25: Free clinical trial search for dogs and cats
L26: # Find Veterinary Cancer Clinical Trials
L27: 
L28: Answer what you know. It is completely fine to choose I don’t know.
L29: 
L30: This finder identifies potentially relevant cancer treatment options. It does not determine eligibility. Final decisions belong to the treating or research team.
L31: 
L32: Before you start
L33: 
L34: Helpful records, if you have them: pathology or cytology, surgery report, recent imaging, bloodwork, and treatment dates. You do not need all of these to search.
L35: 
L36: 1. Your pet
L37: Species[Select]Age (years, optional)[Input: Optional]Weight (optional)[Input: Optional][Select]Country / region[Select]ZIP code (optional)[Input: e.g. 01095]Used only to put closer studies first.
L38: 
L39: 2. Diagnosis
L40: 
L41: Cancer type[Select]How certain is the diagnosis?[Select]Diagnosis as written in the pathology report[Input]
L42: 
L43: 3. Current disease
L44: Current tumor status[Select]Metastases[Select]Has your veterinarian said the disease is localized?[Select]Is the brain tumor currently present on imaging?[Select]Lymphoma type[Select]Response/status[Select]Leukemia status[Select]Mast cell tumor grade[Select]Regional lymph node status[Select]Primary osteosarcoma location[Select]Primary hemangiosarcoma site[Select]Is standard anticancer treatment no longer appropriate or not feasible?[Select]For a large tumor: is it inoperable, or is radiotherapy being chosen instead of surgery?[Select]Are curative surgery and radiotherapy no longer possible for this tumor?[Select]Can current CT imaging and a current tumor biopsy be provided/performed?[Select]
L45: 4. Treatment
L46: 
L47: Surgery[Select]Cancer surgery performed[Select]Chemotherapy[Select]Prior or current cancer immunotherapy[Select]Radiation to this tumor[Select]Prednisone / other corticosteroids[Select]Other immunosuppressive medication[Select]
L48: 
L49: 5. Treatment options
L50: 
L51: Select all that you would consider.
L52: 
L53: [Input]Chemotherapy[Input]Radiation[Input]Surgery[Input]Immunotherapy[Input]Targeted therapy[Input]Experimental drug
L54: Research approach (optional)[Select]Use this to browse a type of experimental treatment. It does not replace diagnosis-based eligibility screening.

L57: 
L58: Urgent symptoms come first. Difficulty breathing, collapse, uncontrolled bleeding, severe pain, or another emergency should be assessed by a veterinarian immediately.
